finding.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection').
Error message handling could lead to undefined behavior if get_error_message returns a null pointer.
Buffer overflow potential if the error message is very long.
Using printf for logging is not ideal for production code.

scan_orig.message: If format strings can be influenced by an attacker, they can be exploited (CWE-134).
No pair for character ("). Can't process file. File is either invalid or unicode, which is currently not supported.
